page.failed: The tracker stopped and could not be restarted.
page.tryAgain: Quit Sensei Top and open it again to try once more.

diagnostics.title: Export diagnostics
diagnostics.playerLog: Player.log names your opponents and your decks. Include it only if you mean to share that.

settings.dateOrder: The date order must be auto, mdy or dmy.
settings.backupKeep: The number of backups kept must be 1 or more.

settings.notSaved: The setting could not be saved.
settings.keyNotSaved: The key could not be saved.
settings.notRead: The settings could not be read.
settings.folderNotOpened: The folder could not be opened.
restore.notStarted: The restore could not be started.
restore.partway: The restore stopped partway. The server stays stopped until the files are put back.
restore.noStatus: The restore ended without a status code.
restore.leftovers: A restore stopped partway, so the server was not started. Rename these files back first: {files}.
cards.restoreRunning: A restore is running. Download once it has finished.
update.checkFailed: The check failed. The reason is in the log.
update.off: Updates are off for this copy.
update.nothingReady: No update is ready to install.
update.installFailed: The update could not be installed. The reason is in the log.
auth.callback.done: You're signed in. You can close this tab and go back to Sensei Top.
auth.callback.failed: Sign-in didn't finish. Close this tab and try again from Sensei Top.
auth.error.unverifiedEmail: This account has no verified email address. Verify the address with the provider you signed in with, then sign in again.
auth.error.timeout: Sign-in timed out after 5 minutes. Try again.
auth.error.noPort: Sign-in needs one of the ports {ports} on this computer, and all of them are in use. Close the program using them and try again.
